notes.title: Version 1.1 is up!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that the first major update for Polismos is finally up :)


Highlighted changes

 Warehouse: store goods for later use!
 Monopteros: small & cheap recreation building
 Delay demands: give yourself some more time 
 Evening mode: for maximum coziness :)
 Lots of balancing to make the game more forgiving, flexible, and fun


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822894/bccfd33990bf0fcbd217d056574879d3973a11b1.png
Warehouses dedicated to wood and stone in the city center can speed up construction significantly


Special thanks to all those active in the Community Hub, your bug reports and feedback has had a huge impact on this update. Now, without further ado, here is the full changelog for 1.1 ...


Additions

 Building: Warehouse
 Building: Monopteros
 Decorative item: Stele
 Lighting mode: Evening
 Ability to postpone demand deadlines
 More demand variety
 More event variety
 Expanded tutorialization


Balancing

 Max simultaneous construction request 5 -> 7
 Highest game speed increased by 10%
 Demands appear less frequently
 Opinion can increase over time with trade partners
 Marble max trade frequency per year 6 -> 8
 Other cities attack later and less frequently


Error fixing

 Improved collision detection for buildings
 Requests from ignored buildings no longer appear in shortage list or in the goods panel list
 Fixed a rare bug which caused armies to not arrive
 Fixed a bug which caused the season visuals to go out of sync
 "Paused" and "Ignore" text no longer incorrectly shows in building panel
 No longer possible to ally invalid cities due to alliance-panel staying open
 Demand to break free can no longer happen when player is currently breaking free
 Horizon now visable in "day" lighting mode
 Fixed a bug which could cause returning army to briefly float in the air
 The number indicating offered goods not shown in building panel now appears correctly
 Spelling corrections


Other

 Volume and frequency reduction of coughing sounds
 Improved demand appearing sound
 Visual changes to the winery building
 Added mouse-over to see additional offered goods in the building panel
 Added another encyclopedia entry
 Other minor UI improvements

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.content:
A (very) small patch to fix a bug...

Errors

 Fixed a bug that could cause save files to not load


As usual, huge thanks to those that take the time to report bugs! :)

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
A small patch to fix a big bug...

Errors

 Fixed a bug which could happen in larger cities. This bug could result in walkers freezing in place, time stopping (not moving to next month), and save files not loading.
 
Please note that loading save files where the "time stopping" issue happened may cause some weird behaviour (like the season visuals not being correct etc.), but all other saves files should be fine.

Huge thanks to those that take their time to report bugs!

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
A (very) small patch to address bugs...

Errors

 Family happiness now changes correctly when revoking unpopular policies
 Towers shoot arrows from the right position even if they have been moved
 The loading screen should now display correctly at game start


If you find any bugs, please let me know! :)

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
A small patch to address bugs and balancing issues...

Errors

 Archer and hoplite numbers are no longer flipped in the mouse-over details
 Innovation completetion estimation is now more accurate
 Moving a building no longer opens the construction panel
 The encyclopedia now shows correct trait info for martial families
 Buildings now maintain rotation when being moved, even if they've been moved before
 Grain aligns properly to ground when loading in
 Right-clicking to close panels is now be more reliable


Balancing

 Families will now get unhappy if their home hasn't finished construction after a year
 Hoplite attack increased to 9 (from 8)
 Tributaries are much more likely to accept requests from the player
 Steam achievement "Trade hub" requirement lowered to 12 (from 20)


Other

 Visual improvement to grain
 Weaver now has sand ground
 Pottery kiln now has sand ground and smoke
 Can now right-click to exit military mode

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
A small patch to address bugs and balancing issues...

Errors

 Fixed a bug that could cause crashes or failure to load files for very large cities
 Fixed a bug that caused the family panel list to "jump" back-and-forth each day
 Fixed a bug which caused attack point indicators to stay on after bribing
 Fixed a bug where allied troops got the benefit of the "Enhanced training" policy
 Corrected some spelling & grammatical errors


Balancing

 Other cities are now less aggressive in general
 Cities with military strength 1 will never attack
 Extra authority gain from legitimacy now happens at 60/80 legit, instead of 70/90
 Demands for expensive buildings now take available public funds into consideration
 The happiness effect of "Extort" now lasts 3 years, instead of 2


Visuals

 Fishing boat movement has been improved
 Grape farm improvements (construction models and ground texture for lv 2)



If you encounter any bugs, or have ideas for how the game can be improved - please let me know! :)
